requirement: The system shall reject an uploaded file whose size exceeds the configured maximum for its category.
The system shall compute a checksum of each uploaded file and store it alongside the file so that later downloads can verify integrity.
The user selects a file and confirms; the system uploads the file, records its metadata and returns a reference for later download.
The system shall generate a CSV report of all orders in a selected date range, with one row per order and the required columns.
The system shall generate a PDF report from the collected data and make it available for download.
As an operations analyst, I want to download a previously generated report so that I can inspect historical figures without regenerating it.
As an operations analyst, I want to schedule a report so that it is regenerated and emailed on a recurring basis.
Every report generation and every file download must be logged with the user, the report or file identifier, and the time, to support data-access auditing.
The uploaded file metadata table shall ensure that each file has a unique storage key, a checksum, and a category from the recognised set.
code:
-- uploaded file metadata table
CREATE TABLE file_metadata (
    file_id         BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    storage_key     VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    original_name   VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    category        VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL,
    content_type    VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    size_bytes      BIGINT       NOT NULL,
    checksum_sha256 CHAR(64)     NOT NULL,
    owner_id        VARCHAR(40)  NOT NULL,
    uploaded_at     TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT file_storage_unique UNIQUE (storage_key),
    CONSTRAINT file_category_chk   CHECK (category IN ('DOCUMENT','IMAGE','VIDEO','AUDIO','ARCHIVE')),
    CONSTRAINT file_size_positive  CHECK (size_bytes >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT file_checksum_len   CHECK (length(checksum_sha256) = 64)
);

CREATE INDEX file_owner_idx ON file_metadata (owner_id, uploaded_at DESC);
hard_negatives:
-- report definition table
CREATE TABLE report_definition (
    report_id    BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    name         VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    report_type  VARCHAR(40)  NOT NULL,
    owner_id     VARCHAR(40)  NOT NULL,
    created_at   TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT report_type_chk CHECK (report_type IN ('ORDERS','INVENTORY','USERS','FINANCE'))
);
-- report schedule table
CREATE TABLE report_schedule (
    schedule_id   BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    report_id     BIGINT       NOT NULL,
    cron_expr     VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    next_run_at   TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
    paused        BOOLEAN      NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    CONSTRAINT schedule_report_fk FOREIGN KEY (report_id) REFERENCES report_definition(report_id)
);

requirement: Only the owner of an uploaded file or a user with the DATA_ADMIN role may download the file.
The scheduled cleanup job shall delete any uploaded file that has been marked as temporary and is older than twenty-four hours, releasing the storage.
